steps.label: VS PRODUCTION
steps.sub: stops a model that is worse

eyebrow: Write the rules down as constants
code:
MIN_AUC = 0.75
# absolute floor on the holdout
MAX_DROP = 0.01
# AUC we may lose vs production
MIN_SLICE_AUC = 0.70
# floor for every contract type
MAX_CALIB_GAP = 0.03
# mean score vs actual churn rate
caption: Reviewers can see and challenge the policy.

code:
p_new = scores(candidate, holdout)
p_old = scores(production, holdout)
auc_new = roc_auc_score(y, p_new)
auc_old = roc_auc_score(y, p_old)

ok = auc_new >= auc_old - MAX_DROP
...
sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)
caption: Same fixed 800-row holdout for both models.

code:
A  retrained     0.801  approved
B  dropped col   0.752  REJECTED
   (passes the 0.75 floor by 0.002;
    fails vs production)
C  C=0.01        0.798  approved

exit code: 0 = pass, 1 = fail
caption: A non-zero exit code fails the CI step.
